cards.prompt: Che programmi hai per il weekend?
cards.answer: Sabato andrò al mare, domenica mi riposo.
cards.notes: What are your plans for the weekend? / On Saturday I'll go to the seaside, on Sunday I'm resting.

cards.answer: Andremo in Sardegna per due settimane.
cards.notes: What will you do this summer? / We'll go to Sardinia for two weeks.
When are you back? / I'll be back on Thursday evening.

cards.answer: Credo di sì, te lo confermo domani.
cards.notes: Will you come to the party? / I think so, I'll confirm tomorrow.
Are you planning to carry on with Italian? / Of course, I want to speak it well.

cards.answer: Saranno le sette, più o meno.
cards.notes: What time would it be? / It must be about seven.
Where's Marco? / He's probably still at the office.
What will the weather be like tomorrow? / They say it will rain.
When are you leaving? / In three days.
Have you decided what to do yet? / Not yet, I'll think about it.

cards.prompt: Mi mandi un messaggio quando arrivi?
cards.answer: Sì, te lo mando appena arrivo.
cards.notes: Will you text me when you arrive? / Yes, I'll send it as soon as I arrive.

cards.answer: Quasi, non vedo l'ora di partire.
cards.notes: Are you ready for the trip? / Almost, I can't wait to leave.
